violated_contract: A privileged control surface is only installed if the Dart VM actually accepted every method name. Recording names into a fake registrar, or calling registerExtension with names the SDK rejects (no ext. prefix), leaves the surface marked available while the VM owns nothing. A test that never executes the real registration cannot catch it.
canonical_prevention: Register ext.omi.controls.* with dart:developer registerExtension, mark installed only after every registration returns, advertise exactly those five suffixes, and compile an opt-in test that calls the SDK for each name then invokes the capabilities handler.
